A Photocopy of a further Certificate from W. E. Hill & Sons, London, dated (Feb. 27th, 1931) June 30th, 1939 Provenance: John Thornley The O'Reilly Crump Family W. E. Hill & Sons Hart & Son Tividor Nachez Fritz Kreisler The Rudolph Wurlitzer Co. History: Alfred Hill relates that he first came into contact with this violin in 1876 when it formed Lot 24 in the sale of the John Thornley Collection at Messrs Foster of Pall Mall on 3rd February. It was purchased by Mr. The O'Reilly, an amateur violinist. His son later sold the instrument to the Crump family. It was then purchased by W. E. Hill & Sons and sold to Tividor Nachez through George Hart. Fritz Kreisler purchased the violin directly from Nachez (See Colour Illustration and Detail of the Head)
